title: Did anyone else get to design their own store in the mall?
content: I had one of those dreams last night where it was like a full movie my head made up, but I kept returning to a mall during parts of it. I recognized one section of the mall and saw a store I apparently made? I was like "Oh yeah I designed this store" and I was very proud of it. Even after waking up I felt like the memory is real. Maybe I did it in a previous dream but it was just a super weird feeling. Can anyone relate?
